          {

          {
            "text": "const GIT4D_KERNELS: &amp;str = r#\"",
            "lineNumber": 256
          },
          {
            "text": "extern \"C\" __global__ void vertex_transform(",
            "lineNumber": 257
          },
          {
            "text": "    const GitCommitVertex* vertices,",
            "lineNumber": 258
          },
          {
            "text": "    const float transform[4][4],",

          },
          {
            "text": "    const RenderParameters* params,",

          },

            "text": "    GitCommitVertex* output,",

          },
          {
            "text": "    unsigned int num_vertices",
            "lineNumber": 262
          },
          {
            "text": ") {",
            "lineNumber": 263
          },
          {
            "text": "    unsigned int idx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;",
            "lineNumber": 264
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (idx &gt;= num_vertices) return;",
            "lineNumber": 265
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 266
          },
          {
            "text": "    GitCommitVertex vertex = vertices[idx];",
            "lineNumber": 267
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 268
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Apply time filtering",
            "lineNumber": 269
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (vertex.time &lt; params-&gt;time_filter.x || vertex.time &gt; params-&gt;time_filter.y) {",
            "lineNumber": 270
          },
          {
            "text": "        // Mark as invisible by setting alpha to 0",
            "lineNumber": 271
          },
          {
            "text": "        vertex.color[3] = 0.0f;",
            "lineNumber": 272
          },
          {
            "text": "        output[idx] = vertex;",
            "lineNumber": 273
          },
          {
            "text": "        return;",
            "lineNumber": 274
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 275
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 276
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Apply branch filtering",
            "lineNumber": 277
          },
          {
            "text": "    bool branch_visible = params-&gt;branch_filter.size == 0;",
            "lineNumber": 278
          },
          {
            "text": "    for (unsigned int i = 0; i &lt; params-&gt;branch_filter.size; ++i) {",
            "lineNumber": 279
          },
          {
            "text": "        if (vertex.branch_id == params-&gt;branch_filter.data[i]) {",
            "lineNumber": 280
          },
          {
            "text": "            branch_visible = true;",
            "lineNumber": 281
          },
          {
            "text": "            break;",
            "lineNumber": 282
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 283
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 284
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 285
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (!branch_visible) {",

          },
          {
            "text": "        vertex.color[3] = 0.0f;",
            "lineNumber": 287
          },
          {
            "text": "        output[idx] = vertex;",
            "lineNumber": 288
          },
          {
            "text": "        return;",
            "lineNumber": 289
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 290
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 291
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Apply 4x4 transformation matrix",
            "lineNumber": 292
          },
          {
            "text": "    float4 pos = make_float4(vertex.position[0], vertex.position[1], vertex.position[2], 1.0f);",
            "lineNumber": 293
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "    float4 transformed;",
            "lineNumber": 295
          },
          {
            "text": "    transformed.x = transform[0][0] * pos.x + transform[0][1] * pos.y + transform[0][2] * pos.z + transform[0][3] * pos.w;",
            "lineNumber": 296
          },
          {
            "text": "    transformed.y = transform[1][0] * pos.x + transform[1][1] * pos.y + transform[1][2] * pos.z + transform[1][3] * pos.w;",
            "lineNumber": 297
          },
          {
            "text": "    transformed.z = transform[2][0] * pos.x + transform[2][1] * pos.y + transform[2][2] * pos.z + transform[2][3] * pos.w;",
            "lineNumber": 298
          },
          {
            "text": "    transformed.w = transform[3][0] * pos.x + transform[3][1] * pos.y + transform[3][2] * pos.z + transform[3][3] * pos.w;",
            "lineNumber": 299
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 300
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (transformed.w != 0.0f) {",
            "lineNumber": 301
          },
          {
            "text": "        transformed.x /= transformed.w;",
            "lineNumber": 302
          },
          {
            "text": "        transformed.y /= transformed.w;",
            "lineNumber": 303
          },
          {
            "text": "        transformed.z /= transformed.w;",
            "lineNumber": 304
          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 306
          },
          {
            "text": "    vertex.position[0] = transformed.x;",

          },
          {
            "text": "    vertex.position[1] = transformed.y;",
            "lineNumber": 308
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 310
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 313
          },
          {
            "text": "extern \"C\" __global__ void time_projection(",
            "lineNumber": 314
          },
          {
            "text": "    const GitCommitVertex* vertices,",
            "lineNumber": 315
          },
          {
            "text": "    float time_axis,",
            "lineNumber": 316
          },
          {
            "text": "    float w_axis,",
            "lineNumber": 317
          },
          {
            "text": "    float3* output_positions,",
            "lineNumber": 318
          },
          {
            "text": "    unsigned int num_vertices",
            "lineNumber": 319
          },
          {
            "text": ") {",
            "lineNumber": 320
          },
          {
            "text": "    unsigned int idx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;",
            "lineNumber": 321
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (idx &gt;= num_vertices) return;",
            "lineNumber": 322
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 323
          },
          {
            "text": "    GitCommitVertex vertex = vertices[idx];",
            "lineNumber": 324
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 325
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Project 4D (x,y,z,t) to 3D using perspective projection",
            "lineNumber": 326
          },
          {
            "text": "    float w = 1.0f + vertex.time * time_axis + vertex.position[2] * w_axis;",
            "lineNumber": 327
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (w != 0.0f) {",
            "lineNumber": 328
          },
          {
            "text": "        output_positions[idx] = make_float3(",
            "lineNumber": 329
          },
          {
            "text": "            vertex.position[0] / w,",
            "lineNumber": 330
          },
          {
            "text": "            vertex.position[1] / w,",
            "lineNumber": 331
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 332
          },
          {
            "text": "        );",
            "lineNumber": 333
          },
          {
            "text": "    } else {",
            "lineNumber": 334
          },
          {
            "text": "        output_positions[idx] = make_float3(",
            "lineNumber": 335
          },
          {
            "text": "            vertex.position[0],",
            "lineNumber": 336
          },
          {
            "text": "            vertex.position[1],",
            "lineNumber": 337
          },
          {
            "text": "            vertex.position[2]",

          },
          {
            "text": "        );",
            "lineNumber": 339
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 340
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 341
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 342
          },
          {
            "text": "extern \"C\" __global__ void render_commits(",
            "lineNumber": 343
          },
          {
            "text": "    const GitCommitVertex* vertices,",
            "lineNumber": 344
          },
          {
            "text": "    const RenderParameters* params,",
            "lineNumber": 345
          },
          {
            "text": "    unsigned int* framebuffer,",
            "lineNumber": 346
          },
          {
            "text": "    unsigned int num_vertices,",
            "lineNumber": 347
          },
          {
            "text": "    unsigned int width,",
            "lineNumber": 348
          },
          {
            "text": "    unsigned int height",
            "lineNumber": 349
          },
          {
            "text": ") {",
            "lineNumber": 350
          },
          {
            "text": "    unsigned int idx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;",
            "lineNumber": 351
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (idx &gt;= num_vertices) return;",
            "lineNumber": 352
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 353
          },
          {
            "text": "    GitCommitVertex vertex = vertices[idx];",
            "lineNumber": 354
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 355
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Skip invisible vertices",
            "lineNumber": 356
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (vertex.color[3] &lt;= 0.0f) return;",
            "lineNumber": 357
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 358
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Apply camera transformation and projection",
            "lineNumber": 359
          },
          {
            "text": "    float3 view_pos = make_float3(",
            "lineNumber": 360
          },
          {
            "text": "        vertex.position[0] - params-&gt;camera_position[0],",
            "lineNumber": 361
          },
          {
            "text": "        vertex.position[1] - params-&gt;camera_position[1],",
            "lineNumber": 362
          },
          {
            "text": "        vertex.position[2] - params-&gt;camera_position[2]",
            "lineNumber": 363
          },
          {
            "text": "    );",
            "lineNumber": 364
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 365
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Simple perspective projection",
            "lineNumber": 366
          },
          {
            "text": "    float aspect = (float)width / (float)height;",
            "lineNumber": 367
          },
          {
            "text": "    float fov = 3.14159f / 4.0f; // 45 degrees",
            "lineNumber": 368
          },
          {
            "text": "    float tan_half_fov = tanf(fov / 2.0f);",
            "lineNumber": 369
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 370
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (view_pos.z &gt; 0.1f) {",
            "lineNumber": 371
          },
          {
            "text": "        float screen_x = view_pos.x / (view_pos.z * tan_half_fov * aspect);",
            "lineNumber": 372
          },
          {
            "text": "        float screen_y = view_pos.y / (view_pos.z * tan_half_fov);",
            "lineNumber": 373
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 374
          },
          {
            "text": "        // Convert to pixel coordinates",
            "lineNumber": 375
          },
          {
            "text": "        int pixel_x = (int)((screen_x + 1.0f) * 0.5f * (float)width);",
            "lineNumber": 376
          },
          {
            "text": "        int pixel_y = (int)((1.0f - screen_y) * 0.5f * (float)height);",
            "lineNumber": 377
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 378
          },
          {
            "text": "        // Check bounds",
            "lineNumber": 379
          },
          {
            "text": "        if (pixel_x &gt;= 0 &amp;&amp; pixel_x &lt; width &amp;&amp; pixel_y &gt;= 0 &amp;&amp; pixel_y &lt; height) {",
            "lineNumber": 380
          },
          {
            "text": "            // Convert RGBA to BGRA and pack into u32",
            "lineNumber": 381
          },
          {
            "text": "            unsigned char r = (unsigned char)(vertex.color[0] * 255.0f);",
            "lineNumber": 382
          },
          {
            "text": "            unsigned char g = (unsigned char)(vertex.color[1] * 255.0f);",
            "lineNumber": 383
          },
          {
            "text": "            unsigned char b = (unsigned char)(vertex.color[2] * 255.0f);",
            "lineNumber": 384
          },
          {
            "text": "            unsigned char a = (unsigned char)(vertex.color[3] * 255.0f);",
            "lineNumber": 385
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 386

          {
            "text": "    pub fn calculate_optimal_camera(",
            "lineNumber": 196
          },
          {
            "text": "        &amp;self,",
            "lineNumber": 197
          },
          {
            "text": "        vertices: &amp;[GitCommitVertex],",
            "lineNumber": 198
          },
          {
            "text": "    ) -&gt; Result&lt;([f32; 3], [f32; 3]), Box&lt;dyn std::error::Error&gt;&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 199
          },
          {
            "text": "        if vertices.is_empty() {",
            "lineNumber": 200
          },
          {
            "text": "            return Ok(([0.0, 0.0, 10.0], [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]));",
            "lineNumber": 201
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 202
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 203
          },
          {
            "text": "        // Find bounding box",
            "lineNumber": 204
          },
          {
            "text": "        let mut min_pos = [f32::INFINITY; 3];",
            "lineNumber": 205
          },
          {
            "text": "        let mut max_pos = [f32::NEG_INFINITY; 3];",
            "lineNumber": 206
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 207
          },
          {
            "text": "        for vertex in vertices {",
            "lineNumber": 208
          },
          {
            "text": "            for i in 0..3 {",
            "lineNumber": 209
          },
          {
            "text": "                min_pos[i] = min_pos[i].min(vertex.position[i]);",
            "lineNumber": 210
          },
          {
            "text": "                max_pos[i] = max_pos[i].max(vertex.position[i]);",
            "lineNumber": 211
          },
          {
            "text": "            }",
            "lineNumber": 212
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 213
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 214
          },
          {
            "text": "        // Calculate center",
            "lineNumber": 215
          },
          {
            "text": "        let center = [",
            "lineNumber": 216
          },
          {
            "text": "            (min_pos[0] + max_pos[0]) / 2.0,",
            "lineNumber": 217
          },
          {
            "text": "            (min_pos[1] + max_pos[1]) / 2.0,",
            "lineNumber": 218
          },
          {
            "text": "            (min_pos[2] + max_pos[2]) / 2.0,",
            "lineNumber": 219
          },
          {
            "text": "        ];",
            "lineNumber": 220
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 221
          },
          {
            "text": "        // Calculate camera position (outside the bounding box)",
            "lineNumber": 222
          },
          {
            "text": "        let diagonal = [",
            "lineNumber": 223
          },
          {
            "text": "            max_pos[0] - min_pos[0],",
            "lineNumber": 224
          },
          {
            "text": "            max_pos[1] - min_pos[1],",
            "lineNumber": 225
          },
          {
            "text": "            max_pos[2] - min_pos[2],",
            "lineNumber": 226
          },
          {
            "text": "        ];",
            "lineNumber": 227
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 228
          },
          {
            "text": "        let max_diagonal = diagonal.iter().fold(0.0, |a, &amp;b| a.max(b));",
            "lineNumber": 229
          },
          {
            "text": "        let camera_distance = max_diagonal * 2.0;",
            "lineNumber": 230
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 231
          },
          {
            "text": "        let camera_pos = [",
            "lineNumber": 232
          },
          {
            "text": "            center[0],",
            "lineNumber": 233
          },
          {
            "text": "            center[1] - camera_distance,",
            "lineNumber": 234
          },
          {
            "text": "            center[2] + camera_distance * 0.5,",
            "lineNumber": 235
          },
          {
            "text": "        ];",
            "lineNumber": 236
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 237
          },
          {
            "text": "        Ok((camera_pos, center))",
            "lineNumber": 238
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 239
          },

            "lineNumber": 240
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Perform GPU-accelerated collision detection for VR interaction",

          },

          },

          },

          },

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "    ) -&gt; Result&lt;Vec&lt;(usize, f32)&gt;, Box&lt;dyn std::error::Error&gt;&gt; {",

          },
          {

          },

          },
          {

          {
            "lineNumber": 254
          },
          {
            "text": "// CUDA kernel code for Git4D visualization",
            "lineNumber": 255
          },
          {
            "text": "const GIT4D_KERNELS: &amp;str = r#\"",
            "lineNumber": 256
          },
          {
            "text": "extern \"C\" __global__ void vertex_transform(",
            "lineNumber": 257
          },
          {
            "text": "    const GitCommitVertex* vertices,",
            "lineNumber": 258
          },
          {
            "text": "    const float transform[4][4],",
            "lineNumber": 259
          },
          {
            "text": "    const RenderParameters* params,",
            "lineNumber": 260
          },
          {
            "text": "    GitCommitVertex* output,",
            "lineNumber": 261
          },
          {
            "text": "    unsigned int num_vertices",
            "lineNumber": 262
          },
          {
            "text": ") {",
            "lineNumber": 263
          },
          {
            "text": "    unsigned int idx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;",
            "lineNumber": 264
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (idx &gt;= num_vertices) return;",
            "lineNumber": 265
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 266
          },
          {
            "text": "    GitCommitVertex vertex = vertices[idx];",
            "lineNumber": 267
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 268
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Apply time filtering",
            "lineNumber": 269
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (vertex.time &lt; params-&gt;time_filter.x || vertex.time &gt; params-&gt;time_filter.y) {",
            "lineNumber": 270
          },
          {
            "text": "        // Mark as invisible by setting alpha to 0",
            "lineNumber": 271
          },
          {
            "text": "        vertex.color[3] = 0.0f;",
            "lineNumber": 272
          },
          {
            "text": "        output[idx] = vertex;",
            "lineNumber": 273
          },
          {
            "text": "        return;",
            "lineNumber": 274
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 275
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 276
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Apply branch filtering",
            "lineNumber": 277
          },
          {
            "text": "    bool branch_visible = params-&gt;branch_filter.size == 0;",
            "lineNumber": 278
          },
          {
            "text": "    for (unsigned int i = 0; i &lt; params-&gt;branch_filter.size; ++i) {",
            "lineNumber": 279
          },
          {
            "text": "        if (vertex.branch_id == params-&gt;branch_filter.data[i]) {",
            "lineNumber": 280
          },
          {
            "text": "            branch_visible = true;",
            "lineNumber": 281
          },
          {
            "text": "            break;",
            "lineNumber": 282
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 283
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 284
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 285
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (!branch_visible) {",
            "lineNumber": 286
          },
          {
            "text": "        vertex.color[3] = 0.0f;",
            "lineNumber": 287
          },
          {
            "text": "        output[idx] = vertex;",
            "lineNumber": 288
          },
          {
            "text": "        return;",
            "lineNumber": 289
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 290
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 291
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Apply 4x4 transformation matrix",
            "lineNumber": 292
          },
          {
            "text": "    float4 pos = make_float4(vertex.position[0], vertex.position[1], vertex.position[2], 1.0f);",
            "lineNumber": 293
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 294
          },
          {
            "text": "    float4 transformed;",
            "lineNumber": 295
          },
          {
            "text": "    transformed.x = transform[0][0] * pos.x + transform[0][1] * pos.y + transform[0][2] * pos.z + transform[0][3] * pos.w;",
            "lineNumber": 296
          },
          {
            "text": "    transformed.y = transform[1][0] * pos.x + transform[1][1] * pos.y + transform[1][2] * pos.z + transform[1][3] * pos.w;",
            "lineNumber": 297
          },
          {
            "text": "    transformed.z = transform[2][0] * pos.x + transform[2][1] * pos.y + transform[2][2] * pos.z + transform[2][3] * pos.w;",
            "lineNumber": 298
          },
          {
            "text": "    transformed.w = transform[3][0] * pos.x + transform[3][1] * pos.y + transform[3][2] * pos.z + transform[3][3] * pos.w;",
            "lineNumber": 299
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 300
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (transformed.w != 0.0f) {",
            "lineNumber": 301
          },
          {
            "text": "        transformed.x /= transformed.w;",
            "lineNumber": 302
          },
          {
            "text": "        transformed.y /= transformed.w;",
            "lineNumber": 303
          },
          {
            "text": "        transformed.z /= transformed.w;",
            "lineNumber": 304
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 305
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 306
          },
          {
            "text": "    vertex.position[0] = transformed.x;",
            "lineNumber": 307
          },
          {
            "text": "    vertex.position[1] = transformed.y;",
            "lineNumber": 308
          },
          {
            "text": "    vertex.position[2] = transformed.z;",
            "lineNumber": 309
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 310
          },
          {
            "text": "    output[idx] = vertex;",
            "lineNumber": 311
          },

            "lineNumber": 312
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 313
          },
          {
            "text": "extern \"C\" __global__ void time_projection(",
            "lineNumber": 314
          },
          {
            "text": "    const GitCommitVertex* vertices,",
            "lineNumber": 315
          },
          {
            "text": "    float time_axis,",
            "lineNumber": 316
          },
          {
            "text": "    float w_axis,",
            "lineNumber": 317
          },
          {
            "text": "    float3* output_positions,",
            "lineNumber": 318
          },
          {
            "text": "    unsigned int num_vertices",
            "lineNumber": 319
          },
          {
            "text": ") {",
            "lineNumber": 320
          },
          {
            "text": "    unsigned int idx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;",
            "lineNumber": 321
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (idx &gt;= num_vertices) return;",
            "lineNumber": 322
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 323
          },
          {
            "text": "    GitCommitVertex vertex = vertices[idx];",
            "lineNumber": 324
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 325
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Project 4D (x,y,z,t) to 3D using perspective projection",
            "lineNumber": 326
          },
          {
            "text": "    float w = 1.0f + vertex.time * time_axis + vertex.position[2] * w_axis;",
            "lineNumber": 327
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (w != 0.0f) {",
            "lineNumber": 328
          },
          {
            "text": "        output_positions[idx] = make_float3(",
            "lineNumber": 329
          },
          {
            "text": "            vertex.position[0] / w,",
            "lineNumber": 330
          },
          {
            "text": "            vertex.position[1] / w,",
            "lineNumber": 331
          },
          {
            "text": "            vertex.position[2] / w",
            "lineNumber": 332
          },
          {
            "text": "        );",
            "lineNumber": 333
          },
          {
            "text": "    } else {",
            "lineNumber": 334
          },
          {
            "text": "        output_positions[idx] = make_float3(",
            "lineNumber": 335
          },
          {
            "text": "            vertex.position[0],",
            "lineNumber": 336
          },
          {
            "text": "            vertex.position[1],",
            "lineNumber": 337
          },
          {
            "text": "            vertex.position[2]",
            "lineNumber": 338
          },
          {
            "text": "        );",
            "lineNumber": 339
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 340
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 341
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 342
          },
          {
            "text": "extern \"C\" __global__ void render_commits(",
            "lineNumber": 343
          },
          {
            "text": "    const GitCommitVertex* vertices,",
            "lineNumber": 344
          },
          {
            "text": "    const RenderParameters* params,",
            "lineNumber": 345
          },
          {
            "text": "    unsigned int* framebuffer,",
            "lineNumber": 346
          },
          {
            "text": "    unsigned int num_vertices,",
            "lineNumber": 347
          },
          {
            "text": "    unsigned int width,",
            "lineNumber": 348
          },
          {
            "text": "    unsigned int height",
            "lineNumber": 349
          },
          {
            "text": ") {",
            "lineNumber": 350
          },
          {
            "text": "    unsigned int idx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;",
            "lineNumber": 351
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (idx &gt;= num_vertices) return;",
            "lineNumber": 352
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 353
          },
          {
            "text": "    GitCommitVertex vertex = vertices[idx];",
            "lineNumber": 354
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 355
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Skip invisible vertices",
            "lineNumber": 356
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (vertex.color[3] &lt;= 0.0f) return;",
            "lineNumber": 357
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 358
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Apply camera transformation and projection",
            "lineNumber": 359
          },
          {
            "text": "    float3 view_pos = make_float3(",
            "lineNumber": 360
          },
          {
            "text": "        vertex.position[0] - params-&gt;camera_position[0],",
            "lineNumber": 361
          },
          {
            "text": "        vertex.position[1] - params-&gt;camera_position[1],",
            "lineNumber": 362
          },
          {
            "text": "        vertex.position[2] - params-&gt;camera_position[2]",
            "lineNumber": 363
          },
          {
            "text": "    );",
            "lineNumber": 364
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 365
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Simple perspective projection",
            "lineNumber": 366
          },
          {
            "text": "    float aspect = (float)width / (float)height;",
            "lineNumber": 367
          },
          {
            "text": "    float fov = 3.14159f / 4.0f; // 45 degrees",
            "lineNumber": 368
          },
          {
            "text": "    float tan_half_fov = tanf(fov / 2.0f);",
            "lineNumber": 369
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 370
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (view_pos.z &gt; 0.1f) {",
            "lineNumber": 371
          },
          {
            "text": "        float screen_x = view_pos.x / (view_pos.z * tan_half_fov * aspect);",
            "lineNumber": 372
          },
          {
            "text": "        float screen_y = view_pos.y / (view_pos.z * tan_half_fov);",
            "lineNumber": 373
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 374
          },
          {
            "text": "        // Convert to pixel coordinates",
            "lineNumber": 375
          },
          {
            "text": "        int pixel_x = (int)((screen_x + 1.0f) * 0.5f * (float)width);",
            "lineNumber": 376
          },
          {
            "text": "        int pixel_y = (int)((1.0f - screen_y) * 0.5f * (float)height);",
            "lineNumber": 377
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 378
          },
          {
            "text": "        // Check bounds",
            "lineNumber": 379
          },
          {
            "text": "        if (pixel_x &gt;= 0 &amp;&amp; pixel_x &lt; width &amp;&amp; pixel_y &gt;= 0 &amp;&amp; pixel_y &lt; height) {",
            "lineNumber": 380
          },
          {
            "text": "            // Convert RGBA to BGRA and pack into u32",
            "lineNumber": 381
          },
          {
            "text": "            unsigned char r = (unsigned char)(vertex.color[0] * 255.0f);",
            "lineNumber": 382
          },
          {
            "text": "            unsigned char g = (unsigned char)(vertex.color[1] * 255.0f);",
            "lineNumber": 383
          },
          {
            "text": "            unsigned char b = (unsigned char)(vertex.color[2] * 255.0f);",
            "lineNumber": 384
          },
          {
            "text": "            unsigned char a = (unsigned char)(vertex.color[3] * 255.0f);",
            "lineNumber": 385
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 386
          },
          {
            "text": "            unsigned int color = (a &lt;&lt; 24) | (r &lt;&lt; 16) | (g &lt;&lt; 8) | b;",
            "lineNumber": 387
          },
          {
            "text": "            framebuffer[pixel_y * width + pixel_x] = color;",
            "lineNumber": 388
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 389
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 390
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 391
          }
        ]

          },

          },

          },

          },
          {

          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 633
          },
          {
            "text": "        // Render to framebuffer",

          },
          {
            "text": "        let mut framebuffer = vec![0u32; (config.render_width * config.render_height) as usize];",

          {
            "lineNumber": 636
          },
          {
            "text": "        if let Some(cuda) = &amp;self.cuda_accelerator {",

          },

          {
            "text": "    /// CPU fallback for framebuffer rendering",
            "lineNumber": 930
          },
          {
            "text": "    fn render_to_framebuffer_cpu(&amp;self, vertices: &amp;[GitCommitVertex], framebuffer: &amp;mut [u32], params: &amp;RenderParameters) {",
            "lineNumber": 931
          },
          {
            "text": "        // Simple CPU-based rendering",
            "lineNumber": 932
          },
          {
            "text": "        for vertex in vertices {",
            "lineNumber": 933
          },
          {
            "text": "            if vertex.color[3] &lt;= 0.0 {",
            "lineNumber": 934
          },
          {
            "text": "                continue;",
            "lineNumber": 935
          },
          {
            "text": "            }",
            "lineNumber": 936
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 937
          },
          {
            "text": "            // Simple projection (simplified for CPU fallback)",
            "lineNumber": 938
          },
          {
            "text": "            let screen_x = ((vertex.position[0] + 1.0) * 0.5 * params.viewport_width as f32) as i32;",
            "lineNumber": 939
          },
          {
            "text": "            let screen_y = ((1.0 - (vertex.position[1] + 1.0) * 0.5) * params.viewport_height as f32) as i32;",
            "lineNumber": 940
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 941
          },
          {
            "text": "            if screen_x &gt;= 0 &amp;&amp; screen_x &lt; params.viewport_width as i32 &amp;&amp;",
            "lineNumber": 942
          },
          {
            "text": "               screen_y &gt;= 0 &amp;&amp; screen_y &lt; params.viewport_height as i32 {",
            "lineNumber": 943
          },
          {
            "text": "                let pixel_index = (screen_y * params.viewport_width as i32 + screen_x) as usize;",
            "lineNumber": 944
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 945
          },
          {
            "text": "                if pixel_index &lt; framebuffer.len() {",
            "lineNumber": 946
          },
          {
            "text": "                    let r = (vertex.color[0] * 255.0) as u32;",
            "lineNumber": 947
          },
          {
            "text": "                    let g = (vertex.color[1] * 255.0) as u32;",

          },
          {

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-rs\\responses-api-proxy\\README.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 36
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# codex-responses-api-proxy",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "A strict HTTP proxy that only forwards &#96;POST&#96; requests to &#96;/v1/responses&#96; to the OpenAI API (&#96;https://api.openai.com&#96;), injecting the &#96;Authorization: Bearer $OPENAI_API_KEY&#96; header. Everything else is rejected with &#96;403 Forbidden&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "## Expected Usage",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "**IMPORTANT:** &#96;codex-responses-api-proxy&#96; is designed to be run by a privileged user with access to &#96;OPENAI_API_KEY&#96; so that an unprivileged user cannot inspect or tamper with the process. Though if &#96;--http-shutdown&#96; is specified, an unprivileged user _can_ make a &#96;GET&#96; request to &#96;/shutdown&#96; to shutdown the server, as an unprivileged user could not send &#96;SIGTERM&#96; to kill the process.",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "A privileged user (i.e., &#96;root&#96; or a user with &#96;sudo&#96;) who has access to &#96;OPENAI_API_KEY&#96; would run the following to start the server, as &#96;codex-responses-api-proxy&#96; reads the auth token from &#96;stdin&#96;:",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;shell",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "printenv OPENAI_API_KEY | env -u OPENAI_API_KEY codex-responses-api-proxy --http-shutdown --server-info /tmp/server-info.json",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "A non-privileged user would then run Codex as follows, specifying the &#96;model_provider&#96; dynamically:",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;shell",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "PROXY_PORT=$(jq .port /tmp/server-info.json)",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "PROXY_BASE_URL=\"http://127.0.0.1:${PROXY_PORT}\"",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "codex exec -c \"model_providers.openai-proxy={ name = 'OpenAI Proxy', base_url = '${PROXY_BASE_URL}/v1', wire_api='responses' }\" \\",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "    -c model_provider=\"openai-proxy\" \\",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "    'Your prompt here'",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "When the unprivileged user was finished, they could shutdown the server using &#96;curl&#96; (since &#96;kill -SIGTERM&#96; is not an option):",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;shell",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "curl --fail --silent --show-error \"${PROXY_BASE_URL}/shutdown\"",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "## Behavior",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "- Reads the API key from &#96;stdin&#96;. All callers should pipe the key in (for example, &#96;printenv OPENAI_API_KEY | codex-responses-api-proxy&#96;).",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "- Formats the header value as &#96;Bearer &lt;key&gt;&#96; and attempts to &#96;mlock(2)&#96; the memory holding that header so it is not swapped to disk.",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "- Listens on the provided port or an ephemeral port if &#96;--port&#96; is not specified.",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "- Accepts exactly &#96;POST /v1/responses&#96; (no query string). The request body is forwarded to &#96;https://api.openai.com/v1/responses&#96; with &#96;Authorization: Bearer &lt;key&gt;&#96; set. All original request headers (except any incoming &#96;Authorization&#96;) are forwarded upstream, with &#96;Host&#96; overridden to &#96;api.openai.com&#96;. For other requests, it responds with &#96;403&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 36
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.2779577076435089
    },

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "//! Windows 11 AI API Integration for Codex",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "//! This crate provides integration with Windows 11's native AI APIs,",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "//! enabling OS-level optimizations for AI inference workloads.",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "//! # Features",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - Windows.AI.MachineLearning: DirectML-based inference",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - GPU statistics and optimization",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - Integration with Codex kernel driver",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "//! # Example",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "//! &#96;&#96;&#96;no_run",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "//! use codex_windows_ai::WindowsAiRuntime;",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "//! #[tokio::main]",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "//! async fn main() -&gt; anyhow::Result&lt;()&gt; {",

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "//!     let stats = runtime.get_gpu_stats().await?;",

          },
          {
            "text": "//!     println!(\"GPU Utilization: {}%\", stats.utilization);",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "//!     Ok(())",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "//! }",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "//! &#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 257
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 258
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 259
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 260
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🔌 API統合",
            "lineNumber": 261
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 262
          },
          {
            "text": "### OpenAI/codex Web検索機能",
            "lineNumber": 263
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 264
          },
          {
            "text": "本実装は、OpenAI/codexの公式Web検索実装パターンに準拠しています。",
            "lineNumber": 265
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 266
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 267
          },
          {
            "text": "// OpenAI/codex公式パターン",
            "lineNumber": 268
          },
          {
            "text": "ToolSpec::WebSearch {}",
            "lineNumber": 269
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 270
          },
          {
            "text": "// 本実装での対応",
            "lineNumber": 271
          },
          {
            "text": "impl WebSearchProvider {",
            "lineNumber": 272
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub async fn call_search_api(&amp;self, query: &amp;str) -&gt; Result&lt;Vec&lt;SearchResult&gt;&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 273
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 優先順位に基づいてバックエンドを選択",
            "lineNumber": 274
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 1. Brave Search API",
            "lineNumber": 275
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 2. Google Custom Search",
            "lineNumber": 276
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 3. Bing Web Search",
            "lineNumber": 277
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 4. DuckDuckGo (APIキー不要)",
            "lineNumber": 278
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 279
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 280
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 281
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 282
          },
          {
            "text": "### MCP（Model Context Protocol）統合",
            "lineNumber": 283
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 284
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 285
          },
          {
            "text": "use codex_deep_research::McpSearchProvider;",
            "lineNumber": 286
          },
          {
            "text": "use codex_deep_research::SearchBackend;",
            "lineNumber": 287
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 288
          },
          {
            "text": "let provider = McpSearchProvider::new(",
            "lineNumber": 289
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"http://localhost:3000\".to_string(),",
            "lineNumber": 290
          },
          {
            "text": "    3,  // max_retries",
            "lineNumber": 291
          },
          {
            "text": "    30, // timeout_seconds",
            "lineNumber": 292
          },
          {
            "text": ");",
            "lineNumber": 293
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 294
          },
          {
            "text": "// バックエンドの動的切り替え",
            "lineNumber": 295
          },
          {
            "text": "provider.set_backend(SearchBackend::DuckDuckGo);",
            "lineNumber": 296
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 297
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 298
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 299
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 300
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🛠️ 開発",
            "lineNumber": 301
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 302
          },
          {
            "text": "### ビルド",
            "lineNumber": 303
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 304
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 305
          },
          {
            "text": "# 開発ビルド",
            "lineNumber": 306
          },
          {
            "text": "cargo build -p codex-deep-research",
            "lineNumber": 307
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 308
          },
          {
            "text": "# リリースビルド",
            "lineNumber": 309
          },
          {
            "text": "cargo build --release -p codex-deep-research",
            "lineNumber": 310
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 311
          },
          {
            "text": "# 全機能有効化",
            "lineNumber": 312
          },
          {
            "text": "cargo build --all-features -p codex-deep-research",
            "lineNumber": 313
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 314
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 315
          },
          {
            "text": "### テスト",
            "lineNumber": 316
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 317
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 318
          },
          {
            "text": "# 単体テスト",
            "lineNumber": 319
          },
          {
            "text": "cargo test -p codex-deep-research --lib",
            "lineNumber": 320
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 321
          },
          {
            "text": "# 統合テスト（DuckDuckGo）",
            "lineNumber": 322
          },
          {
            "text": "cargo test -p codex-deep-research --test test_duckduckgo",
            "lineNumber": 323
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 324
          },
          {
            "text": "# 全テスト実行",
            "lineNumber": 325
          },
          {
            "text": "cargo test -p codex-deep-research",
            "lineNumber": 326
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 327
          },
          {
            "text": "# テスト結果表示",
            "lineNumber": 328
          },
          {
            "text": "cargo test -p codex-deep-research -- --nocapture",
            "lineNumber": 329
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 330
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 331
          },
          {
            "text": "### ベンチマーク",

          }
        ]
